source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-16

procedures.title: Lower control arm cross shaft and/or bushings: remove and install
steps: Removal: take off the bolt, lock washer and collar at each end of the cross shaft.
Screw the 7/16 x 20 capscrew supplied with tool J-5888 to the bottom of the threads in one end of the shaft.
Set the arm in an arbor press on support J-5888-3 (see figure 28 in the manual), with the bushing flange clear of the support.
Press on the capscrew until the bushing comes out of the arm; discard it.
notes: Figure 28 shows the capscrew, tool J-7052-1 and support J-5888-3 in the press.
